jp: 最期に言い残す言葉はないか？
en: Lowly demon, Luca. Have you any last words?

jp: お前は最期に言い残す言葉は
en: Lowly demon, Aragi. And you, have you any last words?

jp: クックックックッ・・・・・
en: Kukukuku.....

jp: ヒャーハッハッハッハッハ！！
en: HYAA-HAHAHA!! My last words? Mine?

jp: 寝言は寝てから言えよオッサン
en: Save the sleep-talk for when you're asleep, old man.

jp: 貴様っ、卑しき悪魔の分際で
en: You! Such insolence from a lowly demon!
Gwah!!

jp: 死を前にして強がってるだけだ
en: ...Stop. It's just bravado in the face of death. Leave it.
Sir!

jp: もったいつけねぇで殺すなら
とっととやればいいだろう？
en: Keh! Quit dragging it out. If you're gonna kill us, get on with it.

jp: それともアレか？意中の女を
殺されて、ふぬけにでも
en: Or what? Did having your sweetheart killed turn you into a limp rag?
What?

jp: 殺されたのは女じゃねぇ、
en: ...No, wait. Wasn't a woman that got killed.

jp: 女まがいに着飾ってた
en: It was a man dolled up like one, wasn't it?

jp: お前は天使の事情にも
en: You seem well-informed about angels' affairs.

jp: 十審将さまも、相当オツムが
きちまっているらしい
en: Seems the mighty Tribunal General's gone soft in the head too.
Or what, was it a honey trap?
There's always one of those around...
Grisina...
Don't you sully Grisina!!
Guhah!!
As if you could understand that purity!!

jp: 誰よりも儚く美しい天使だった！
守りたかった！それなのに！！
en: Grisina... frailest and loveliest of all angels! I wanted to protect him! And yet!!

jp: 公衆の面前で恥ずかしい奴め
en: Keh. Embarrassing yourself in front of a crowd.

jp: 茶番はこれまでだ・・・
en: Well, about time. The farce ends here...

jp: ギシャァァァァァァァ！！！
en: GSHAAAAAAAA!!
Gwaaaaah!!
Fshhhh...
Wh-what are these things!?

jp: そいつらはパスカと言ってな
en: Those are called Pasca. My loyal servants.
Aragi!? When did you get out of the chains!!?

jp: こんなもので本当に俺を
捕まえたと思っていたのか？
en: Good grief. Did you really think these things could hold me?
Oh, right... Luca, want me to save you? I'll lend you a hand.

jp: アンタの手なんか借りないよ
en: I don't want your hand.
Heh. That's you all over.

jp: 逃がしはせんぞアラギ！！
en: You won't escape, Aragi!! You die here!!

jp: ケッ、オッサンじゃ俺の相手は
en: Keh. An old man like you is no match for me.

jp: せいぜいお前らはパスカどもと
en: You lot have fun dancing with the Pasca!!

jp: 待てぇぇぇぇぇーーー！！！！！
en: Damn you, you won't get away! Waaaaaaait!!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
